updates.label: Daniel Sroka’s September 16, 2026 interview with Chief Paul — revised transcript

descriptionParagraphs.text: Daniel Sroka finished refining the transcript of his September 16, 2026 interview with American Fork Police Chief Cameron Paul.
The rough transcript was generated using an automated transcription app, then corrected and revised with AI assistance. Eric Seamons and Daniel Sroka subsequently made manual revisions.

updates.label: Daniel Sroka authorizes publication of August 10, 2026 interview audio
updates.description: On October 14, 2026, Daniel Sroka gave permission for this site to publish audio of his August 10, 2026 interview with Mayor Bradley Frost and Chief Cameron Paul.

$override.description: Rob Shelton reports on the federal lawsuit filed October 14 by Sheldon Norcross, Tyler Shaw, Sierra Lauts, and Steven Allen against American Fork City and 13 officers. The complaint alleges constitutional violations; these allegations have not been adjudicated. Ben Schneider is not a plaintiff.
